sheets.title: Landing — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The tree is the sections and nothing else. Add is one button in the corner, with its alternatives behind it.
sheets.before: no corner button; add, import, export and search as bare glyphs in a strip at the top
sheets.after: no strip; a `+` with an attached vertical ellipsis, bottom right

sheets.title: List — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The header is back and the view the list is showing, named. Add is the corner button: `+` for a new item, the ellipsis for the rest.
sheets.before: back, funnel, +, import, export and search as six unlabelled glyphs
sheets.after: back and `All items ▾` across the width; `+ ⋮` in the corner

sheets.title: The ellipsis — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The vertical ellipsis on the Add button opens the alternatives to a new item: Import and Export, as a bottom action sheet.
sheets.before: Import and Export were two bare arrows in a strip at the top; there is no menu
sheets.after: `Add actions` sheet: Import items, Export items

sheets.title: A long press on Add — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Holding the `+` is the same ask as the ellipsis. It does not follow the link.
sheets.before: holding the strip's `+` raised the generic link menu: Open link, Open link in new tab, Copy link address
sheets.after: the same `Add actions` sheet as the ellipsis

sheets.title: Search — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Search is typed into the one text input and the list narrows as it is typed. Before, a search key opened a second box above the first.
sheets.before: two text inputs: a `/` box above the status line, and the prompt below it
sheets.after: one text input, `/? ban`; the list holds 2 of 14 and the status line says so

sheets.title: Enter keeps the words — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Enter commits: the keyboard leaves the field and the words stay in it. Nothing opens over the prompt.
sheets.before: n/a — the old search key had no such state
sheets.after: words kept in the prompt; no notice box; list still narrowed

sheets.title: List — 320 × 568
sheets.caption: The narrowest phone: header, rows and corner button all fit, and the button clears the status line and prompt.
sheets.before: six glyph keys in the header
sheets.after: named view across the header; corner button

sheets.title: Desktop — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Unchanged apart from the search key: the list keeps its icon keys for New, Import and Export, and there is no corner button.
sheets.before: rail + list + buffer; a `/` search key in the list's row
sheets.after: identical without the `/` key; `/` on the keyboard writes `/? ` into the prompt
